consequence.statement: Cilium will incorrectly assume Kubernetes is present when running in --datapath-mode=lb-only for plain Docker mode without the --enable-k8s=false flag, causing operational failures.
consequence.remediation: Add --enable-k8s=false to the Cilium command line when operating in --datapath-mode=lb-only for plain Docker mode.

assertion.statement: Operating Cilium in --datapath-mode=lb-only for plain Docker mode now requires an additional --enable-k8s=false flag on the command line; without it, Kubernetes is assumed to be present.
